system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: livestock_verify_otp and livestock_raise_grievance. For your information, my description is dummy_description_5217, my grievance_category is dummy_grievance_category_1792, my aadhaar_number is 100020009996, my otp is dummy_otp_3931.

function.name: livestock_raise_grievance
function.description: Raises a grievance about livestock vaccination services. Valid categories: 'service_delay', 'vaccination_not_done', 'incorrect_record', 'schedule_issue', 'field_worker_issue'. Must check service/vaccination status first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if category is invalid or duplicate exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: livestock_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for livestock vaccination operations. Does NOT register animals or book vaccinations. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated.
